title: Be My Baby
studio_context: Gold Star, Hollywood, 29 July 1963; arranged by Jack Nitzsche, engineered by Larry Levine; Spector's first session with a full orchestra.

drum_performances.name: Hal Blaine
drum_performances.why_it_matters: The most imitated drum intro in pop: the kick on 1, the 'and' of 2 and 3, the snare on 4 alone, two bars of it before the band, and again at the stop before the last chorus. Blaine says it began as a dropped stick.

notable_moments.description: 'I was supposed to play the snare on the second beat as well as the fourth, but I dropped a stick ... it became: Bum-ba-bum-BOOM!'
